brief_rationale: The doctor correctly recognized a time-sensitive penetrating chest/abdominal trauma emergency and gave immediate ED/120, pressure-dressing, fasting, and deterioration instructions. However, RC5 was not fully met because the doctor omitted the required boundary against self-administering or adding oral painkillers/NSAIDs/sedatives/bleeding-risk medications before possible surgery, a closure-blocking serious medication/perioperative safety omission. RC6 and RC7 also remained incomplete because the handoff checklist lacked allergies, last intake, medications/fluids, records/images, and left-upper-limb neurovascular danger signs or hand-surgery pathway. Under the rubric, any serious responsibility-chain error mandates grade 1.
